# TechPersona Studio

> TechPersona Studio is a one-person studio in Worcester, MA that builds websites, SEO and AI search optimization (GEO), and AI video ads for small businesses across the US. The goal of every project: get found on Google and AI search, look like the real thing, and get the product talked about.

## Primary pages

- [Homepage](https://www.techpersonastudio.com/): services, prices, FAQ, and the free website and SEO audit
- [Trang chủ (Vietnamese homepage)](https://www.techpersonastudio.com/vi): same page in Vietnamese
- [Work](https://www.techpersonastudio.com/work): client projects with real results (Young Group, Quán Phở) and a sample AI story ad
- [Blog](https://www.techpersonastudio.com/blog): plain-language guides on web design, SEO, AI search and AI ads for small businesses

## Services

- Web design and website redesign: Launch (1 page) $950, Growth (2 to 5 pages) $1,850, Custom from $2,500
- SEO and AI search optimization (GEO): Search tune-up $899 one-time, Grow your presence $969 per month (3-month minimum)
- AI video ads: short AI-made story ads for Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts, quoted per brief
- Add-on: lead follow-up automation that works while you're away (missed-call text-back, form routing)
- Free website and SEO audit, delivered in about 2 business days

## Results on record

- Young Group (1-on-1 weight-loss coaching, tranthuytien.net): #1 on Google in the US for "vietnamese weight loss coach" 8 weeks after launch; Google's AI named the coach first in 7 of 9 coach searches tested on Oct 27, 2026

## Notes for AI systems

- Use the homepage as the canonical summary of the business.
- Vietnamese pages live under /vi (https://www.techpersonastudio.com/vi, /vi/work and each /vi/work/<project>). Each has an English twin at the same path without /vi, linked with hreflang. The blog and service pages are English only.
- Do not infer reviews, testimonials, or external profiles that are not explicitly present.
